versions.content: Definition of a pointer to a function An Implementation- DataType or one of its sub-elements can also describe a function pointer. This com- pletes its ability to declare all kinds of local data and of possible arguments used in library calls. A function pointer is defined by the category FUNCTION_REFERENCE and the as- sociation SwPointerTargetProps . functionPointerSignature that refers to a BswModuleEntry . The latter essentially describes the signature of a function as ex- plained in [6].
